confidence_notes: The FX figure is the RBA observation for 18 Nov 2026, found via search of RBA pages. I ran one search for Seattle food and drink prices, and it returned mostly venue-level and partly dated sources. From it: craft pints about $8-11, cocktails about $11-14, cappuccino about $4.75-6, casual meals about $16-22, and dinner for two about $100-130 including tax and tip. I trimmed the dinner figure down to a pre-tax, no-drinks level. The wine glass price is weakly sourced; I set it from the cocktail and beer relationship, with one undated happy-hour listing at $7. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, with no live listings checked, and July is peak season in Seattle. Hostel and 1-star prices are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Seattle is treated as a high-cost West Coast US city, similar to Portland and San Francisco, with prices a bit below San Francisco.
